name: Python Bytecode (__pycache__)
explanation: Compiled Python .pyc files can always be regenerated automatically upon execution.

name: Stale Node Modules
explanation: node_modules directories in projects unaccessed for over 60 days can be reinstalled with npm/yarn install.

name: User Application Caches
explanation: Application cache directory containing temporary downloads and cached thumbnails.

name: Pip & NPM Package Caches
explanation: Package tarball caches kept by package managers.

name: Browser Cache Folders
explanation: Web browser temporary assets, cached images, and scripts.

name: Desktop Image Thumbnails
explanation: Rendered preview thumbnails of desktop files and pictures.

name: Temporary Files (*.tmp, *.temp)
explanation: Editor swap files and process scratch files older than 3 days.

name: Old & Rotated Logs (*.log, *.gz)
explanation: Old application and system logs that have been rotated or inactive for 30+ days.

name: Process Core Dumps
explanation: Memory crash dumps from terminated processes.

name: Old Downloads & OS Images (*.iso, *.deb, *.rpm)
explanation: Operating system images and software installers downloaded 60+ days ago.

name: Old Compressed Archives (*.zip, *.tar.gz)
explanation: Compressed archive files inactive for over 90 days requiring user review.
